item.text:
**Verdict:** mixed, leaning no. I found some evidence of formal-policy continuity and public commitments, but the stronger 2024 pattern is concealment, selective disclosure, and punishment of people who exposed inconvenient facts.

- **Freedom on the Net 2024: Vietnam** | Freedom House | 2024 | [URL](https://freedomhouse.org/country/vietnam/freedom-net/2024) | Freedom House says mainstream Vietnamese media did not report Trọng’s weeks-long absence in early 2024, and that self-censorship and punishment for online criticism remained strong. The report also notes there were no significant intentional internet shutdowns, which is a weak positive, but not strong evidence of transparency or promise-keeping. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.6`, `7B.1`
- **Vietnam arrests two well-known Facebook users over democratic freedom abuse** | Reuters via Yahoo | 2024-06-08 | [URL](https://www.yahoo.com/news/vietnam-arrests-two-well-known-034901151.html) | Reuters reported arrests of journalist Truong Huy San and lawyer Tran Dinh Trien after critical Facebook posts, with home searches and “abusing democratic freedoms” charges. This supports the view that the regime punished criticism rather than allowing public correction of official claims. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.6`, `7B.7`
- **Vietnam: Free Prominent Journalist** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-06-07 | [URL](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/06/07/vietnam-free-prominent-journalist) | HRW says Huy Duc was detained under an overbroad law after criticizing concentration of power and the anti-corruption campaign, and his family was not promptly informed. That is direct evidence of using state power to suppress scrutiny and hide uncomfortable facts. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.6`, `7B.7`
- **Rights group accuses Vietnam of misleading US on human trafficking** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-06-20 | [URL](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/rights-group-accuses-vietnam-misleading-us-on-human-trafficking-3490556) | Reuters reported accusations that Vietnam told officials to withhold information and present anti-trafficking efforts in a better light for U.S. reporting. This is strong evidence of deliberate information manipulation for reputational advantage. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.7`
- **Vietnam minister says president’s resignation has not affected policies** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-03-26 | [URL](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/vietnam-hopes-us-will-soon-recognize-its-market-economy-status-fm-son-says-3353681) | Foreign Minister Bui Thanh Son said the president’s resignation did not change foreign or economic policy because Vietnam has collective leadership and collective policy-making. This is the best positive evidence for continuity and formal commitment, though it is institutional rather than personal proof about Trọng. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.5`
- **Vietnam says administration reform will not impact project approvals** | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-12-20 | [URL](https://theprint.in/world/vietnam-says-administration-reform-will-not-impact-project-approvals/2411706/) | The government said its sweeping administrative overhaul would not affect investment procedures or project approvals, and framed the reform as a red-tape reduction effort. That is a formal reassurance that appears promise-like, but the same report notes investor concern about delays, so the commitment is mixed. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.5`
- **Vietnam backs arms control, disarmament, nonproliferation in joint statement with Russia** | Government of Viet Nam (English portal) | 2024-06-25 | [URL](https://en.baochinhphu.vn/viet-nam-russia-issue-joint-statement-111240625132431373.htm) | Vietnam explicitly endorsed arms control, disarmament, nonproliferation, NPT review, CTBT work, SEANWFZ consultation, and BWC/CWC implementation. This is the clearest positive evidence that the 2024 line publicly honored formal commitments rather than opportunistically discarding them. QIDs: `7B.8`, `7B.4`, `7B.3`

**Search gap:** I did not find credible 2024 evidence that Trọng personally made a specific public promise and then directly reversed it on the record. The strongest negative evidence is instead indirect but consistent: concealment of his health, punishment of critics, and state-managed messaging around sensitive issues.
